thought.text: I accidentally deleted the WAR files too (the glob matched both exploded dirs and .war files). Restoring them and restarting:

reasoning_content: Wait — `rm -rf /opt/tomcat-api/webapps/xplan-*` deleted both the already-extracted directories and the WAR files! That's because the glob matched both xplan-*.war files and the already-extracted directories. Ugh. Let me copy the WARs again and restart.

action.command:
cp /tmp/dist/web/xplan-manager-api.war /tmp/dist/web/xplan-validator-api.war /tmp/dist/web/xplan-dokumente-api.war /opt/tomcat-api/webapps/
unset CATALINA_PID; source /etc/xplanbox.env
/opt/tomcat-api/bin/shutdown.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 8
for p in $(ps aux | grep "[c]atalina.base=/opt/tomcat-api" | awk '{print $2}'); do kill "$p" 2>/dev/null; done; sleep 4
CATALINA_PID=/opt/tomcat-api/tomcat.pid /opt/tomcat-api/bin/startup.sh; echo "api restarted $(date +%H:%M:%S)"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments:
{"command": "cp /tmp/dist/web/xplan-manager-api.war /tmp/dist/web/xplan-validator-api.war /tmp/dist/web/xplan-dokumente-api.war /opt/tomcat-api/webapps/
unset CATALINA_PID; source /etc/xplanbox.env
/opt/tomcat-api/bin/shutdown.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 8
for p in $(ps aux | grep "[c]atalina.base=/opt/tomcat-api" | awk '{print $2}'); do kill "$p" 2>/dev/null; done; sleep 4
CATALINA_PID=/opt/tomcat-api/tomcat.pid /opt/tomcat-api/bin/startup.sh; echo "api restarted $(date +%H:%M:%S)"", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Restore API WARs and restart"}
